result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: subscription use extends to Affiliates and contractors acting for Customer, transfer to a permitted successor is allowed, and discretionary revocation is replaced by the uncured-material-breach process in Section 13.3. Section 13.2 already provides the required perpetual and irrevocable paid-up licence. The revision is appropriately limited to Section 13.1 and preserves the existing scope of Sections 13.2 and 13.3. Drafting is professional, though Section 13.3 refers to revocation or suspension rather than expressly to termination, creating a minor terminology mismatch with Section 13.1.
